shortBio.en: Joy Division/New Order bassist; high melodic basslines that often lead the harmony.
shortBio.zh: Joy Division/New Order 贝斯手；常主导和声的高音旋律贝斯线。

whyHub.en: Same JD→NO bridge as Sumner, from the bass register that made post-punk rooms sing.
whyHub.zh: 与 Sumner 同一 JD→NO 桥，来自让后朋克房间发声的贝斯音区。

body.en:
Born 1956. In Joy Division, bass climbs above guitar frost; in New Order, bass learns sequenced dance roles without losing melodic identity. Later disputes over who owns the songs are part of the institutional record.

Bass as character: listen for Hook before the vocal.
body.zh:
1956 年生。在 Joy Division，贝斯爬到吉他冷感之上；在 New Order，贝斯学会音序舞曲角色且不丢旋律身份。后期关于歌曲归属的争执属制度记录。

贝斯即角色：听人声之前先听 Hook。
